log: IS IT REASONING OR MEMORY? -- accuracy vs how much has been PUBLISHED about the answer
The 0.720 open-ended result may be recall of the literature the answer key was built from.
That decides whether this can fill the ~9,200 unannotated reactions or only transcribe known
biology. Axis = NCBI gene2pubmed, joined on GENE ID -- never string-matched, because CAT, SI
and KL are real symbols AND common words.
The natural sample could not answer it: median catalyst 230 papers, 1 of 200 under 20. A gene
is annotated BECAUSE it was studied. So this benchmark is STRATIFIED to enrich the obscure end.
PREDECLARED: flat curve + controlled slope ~0 => reasoning, transfers to true gaps.
Rising curve => memory, and 0.720 overstates field performance by the top-to-bottom gap.

The last row is the cleanest comparison available: same reaction type, no answer handed
over. It keeps a +0.323 gap, so the effect is not an artefact of either.
The last two rows coincide because NO metabolic puzzle is a giveaway -- metabolite
participants never carry a gene symbol, so both confounds live in the signalling half.
Direction is identical in every subset. Significance weakens in the metabolic-only fit
(p=0.0616) because n falls to 313 with only 36 in the top bin,
not because the effect goes away.
READING
MEMORY IS DOING REAL WORK. Controlled slope +0.369 (p=0.0448): accuracy rises with
how much has been published about the answer, by +0.350 from the bottom bin to the top.
On genuinely obscure enzymes the arm scores 0.463, not 0.645.
This tool transcribes known-but-unlinked biology. Pointing it at true gaps needs that
discount applied, and the honest expected yield on unannotated reactions is the BOTTOM bin.
WHAT TO EXPECT ON THE 9,186 unannotated ENZYME-SHAPED reactions (metabolic + transition;
binding and dissociation steps are excluded -- they are spontaneous and correctly have no
catalyst): the bottom-bin accuracy
0.463 is the closest honest estimate, NOT the headline 0.645 -- true
gaps are obscure by construction, so the obscure bin is the population that resembles them.
Treat even that as an UPPER bound. Every reaction here has a curated catalyst, so its chemistry
was clean enough for a curator to assign one. The unannotated reactions have not passed that
filter, and nothing measured here says they are as tractable.
